name: Nullweave Synth Jazz Performer's Stage Rig
description: High-waisted wide-leg trousers in black velvet-analog with a subtle iridescent weft, paired with a sleeveless mandarin-collar top in deep oxblood that leaves both chrome arms fully exposed from the shoulder socket down. A single long silk-analog scarf in cobalt and gold is draped asymmetrically across one shoulder. The synthetic body proportions — elongated fingers, slightly too-wide shoulders — make it look architectural.
functionality: Full chrome arm exposure allows unimpeded performance range; scarf can be secured to prevent stage hazard.
what_it_says: A synthetic who has chosen beauty deliberately, performing humanity back at the humans watching.
story_hooks: The scarf is the only item the synthetic owns from before their previous owner — they don't know what it means, only that they kept it.
A Spire talent scout in the audience tonight has a contract offer that would require the synthetic to register as property again.

physical_description.visual_profile: A striking performance silhouette that celebrates chromatic augmentation. The high-waisted trousers create an elongated torso, while the sleeveless oxblood top frames bare chrome cybernetics with theatrical intention. The asymmetric cobalt-gold scarf adds movement and draws the eye across the body in geometric patterns. Overall impression: intentional, architectural, unapologetically augmented.
physical_description.fit: High-waisted with a dramatic wide-leg cut that drapes from hip to ankle without restriction. The sleeveless mandarin-collar top is tailored through the shoulders but leaves the arms completely bare from shoulder socket down, emphasizing the transition between organic shoulder and chrome. Proportionally cut for synthetic frames — slightly wider at the shoulders, accommodating extended reach and articulation.
physical_description.primary_material: Velvet-analog synth-weave (trousers), lab-grown oxblood linen composite (top), silk-analog with embedded iridescent micro-threads (scarf)
physical_description.texture: The trousers have a soft, light-reflective pile surface with a subtle iridescent weft that catches stage lighting. The top is crisp yet drapes subtly, with a matte finish that contrasts against exposed chrome. The scarf has a fluid, slippery drape with embedded holochromic threads.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep black with iridescent undertones (trousers), oxblood red/deep burgundy (top), cobalt blue with gold linear accents (scarf). High contrast between warm and cool tones creates visual tension.
closures: Trousers: concealed magnetic side seam with friction-fit waistband
Top: magnetic snap closures at mandarin collar, none required at sides
Scarf: draped and tucked, no closure needed
distinctive_features: Fully exposed chrome cybernetic arms — the outfit is designed around this augmentation, not despite it
Iridescent weft in trousers that creates a shimmering halo under stage lighting
Asymmetric scarf drape that creates dynamic line and movement potential during performance
Mandarin collar echoes influences from pre-Collapse East Asian formality codes
High waistline emphasizes elongated synthetic proportions
Seamless integration between garment and chrome — no awkward coverage or gaps
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2 luxury — custom Nullweave work commands premium pricing, designed for performers with significant augmentation budgets and stage presence
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by elite jazz performers and stage entertainers in the GLMZ club scene. The visible chrome signals both technical investment and aesthetic statement — this wearer is neither hiding augmentation nor fetishizing it, but incorporating it into artistic expression. Common in high-end venue performances, private corpo events, and the avant-garde music circuit.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to well-maintained broken-in. Stage performers keep these rigs in excellent condition between performances. Minor scuff marks on chrome from cables or stage contact. Occasional faint stage makeup residue on collar. Scarf may show slight fraying at edges from repeated draping.
